screen: M1 length-weighted named-road version IQR county-held-out residual screen; descriptive-only unless fixed gates pass

method.feature: Within each official tract, length-weighted empirical IQR (weighted Q75 minus weighted Q25) across the segment-level arithmetic mean of distinct matching supplied OSM way-version integers for named road classes. Segment clipped length in EPSG:5070 is the weight.
method.version_parser: Only provided Overture roads.sources.record_id values from source dataset OpenStreetMap fully matching ^w\d+@(\d+)$, case-insensitive; no external history.
method.segment_version: Deduplicate integer versions within each road geometry, then arithmetic mean, exactly matching M1 named_mean_version and the preceding p90 screen.
method.weighted_quantile: Sort values stably and select the first segment value whose cumulative clipped length reaches q times total length; IQR=Q75-Q25. Fixed empirical convention; no tuning.
method.geometry: Provided road geometries intersected with provided official ACS tract polygons after transformation to EPSG:5070; use within-tract clipped lengths.
method.outcome: Pinned frozen S1 cross-fitted Queen/Rook disagreement residual; not rebuilt or refit.
method.validation: Fixed within-region leave-one-five-digit-county-FIPS-out folds, exactly matching the preceding named-road mean and p90 screens; same 9,247 paired support.
method.correction: One-term OLS with intercept; feature mean and population SD computed on outer-training tracts only; zero SD scale=1.
method.baseline: Zero correction of frozen S1 residual on identical support.
method.metric: Pooled and regional held-county-out ΔR²=(baseline SSE-OOF model SSE)/baseline SSE; 2,000 paired county-block bootstrap replicates resampled within region.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only, not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county baseline/model SSE blocks; counties sampled with replacement within each official region

maricopa-az.feature: length-weighted empirical IQR of per-segment mean unique supplied OSM way versions
maricopa-az.version_parser: OpenStreetMap source record_id fullmatch ^w\d+@(\d+)$, case-insensitive; only supplied record_id values are parsed
maricopa-az.multiple_versions_per_geometry: deduplicate integer way versions and use their arithmetic mean, matching M1 named_mean_version input parsing
maricopa-az.weighted_quantile: first sorted value whose cumulative clipped length reaches q times total clipped length; q=.25 and .75, stable sort
maricopa-az.geometry_assignment: provided lines and official tract polygons transformed to EPSG:5070; intersect and weight by clipped segment length
